name: Protected Audience on Android (FLEDGE)
plain: On-device ad auctions for remarketing, without sending a person's history to ad servers.
meaning: Would have replaced retargeting with local interest groups and auctions. Retired together with Topics.

android.store_policy: Privacy Sandbox status page lists as scheduled for phaseout (page updated Aug 2026)
android.note: Google announced on 17 Oct 2025 it is retiring this along with most Privacy Sandbox APIs. No Android removal date was stated in the announcement.

limits.headline: Can't count on Android ad auctions on your phone, since Google is retiring them
limits.user_action: Nothing. It was a background feature, and Google announced its retirement on 17 Oct 2025
can: Have kept ad interest groups on the phone (Android 13 and later)
Have run ad auctions on the phone itself
Keep working until Google sets a removal date
cannot: Run on iPhone; it is not an Apple feature
Count on it long term; it is being retired
Show a removal date; none was named
limits.differs: Android only. iPhone never had it.

story.what_it_is: Android's plan for ad auctions on your phone, so your history stays local.

marketing.name: Protected Audience
marketing.pitch: On device ad auctions meant to show ads for interests without sharing a person's history.

story.for_you: You would have seen ads for things you looked at, but the matching would have happened inside your phone, without your history leaving it.
story.for_makers: It was meant to replace retargeting with local interest groups and on device auctions. Google retired it along with Topics in October 2025 after little adoption.

use_cases.example: You look at hiking boots, and later an ad for them appears in a news app, picked by your phone.
A game ad auction picks a promo for a game you tried, locally.
An ad network gets its bid in an on device auction without a user ID.
A news app shows a relevant ad without sharing your reading list.
History stays on the phone, which cuts leaks to data brokers.
A measurement team tests how well on device auctions work against old ID lists.

story.android_note: Google retired it with the rest of the Android Privacy Sandbox plan in October 2025.
story.ios_note: iOS never had a direct equivalent.

technical_bounds: Retired: do not build new features on this
Ad ID stays the main cross-app identifier

legit_uses: Was meant as an ID-free ad system
